registerSource: Phase 259 Plan 02 (Issue #259, D-03/D-03a/D-05/D-06/D-06a/D-07). The DERIVED set — parsed from apps/api/src/contexts/*/api/**/*.ts source text via lint-t100-09-routes.ts, joined against apps/api/src/app.ts's app.register() prefixes — is 76 routes with a path parameter (33 route files, 186 total route declarations). 259-CONTEXT.md's own D-05 measurement states 75: that count came from a grep-shaped scan whose regex could not match a newline between `app.delete(` and the opening path-string quote, and therefore missed apps/api/src/contexts/absence/api/company-shutdowns.ts:183's `app.delete(\n    "/:id/exceptions/:employeeId",`. A newline-tolerant parse (this gate's own extractRouteDeclarations) finds that route, making the real, mechanically-derived figure 76 — the parser was made newline-tolerant to reach this number, not adjusted to match the earlier 75. Every entry below must have route/file/category/reason and, for probe, params (one key per path parameter) and optionally minimalBody; bekannt-abweichend additionally requires ticket + validatedAt (ISO date, expires after 90 days, D-06a corrected). Two genuine T-100-09 violations were measured while building this register and are classified bekannt-abweichend with a new GitHub issue each (#309, #310) — see their entries below; neither handler was touched (D-06).
